structured.answer: The page assumes 2% inflation a year (and 7% growth, its own guess). With 750 ₪ a month for 15 years it says the cheapest place is a Pesagot (פסגות) account with the Yelin Lapidot S&P 500 fund, ending with about 179,889 ₪ in today's money after fees and tax. Paid in: 135,000 ₪. The banks come lower, about 169,000–172,000 ₪, but I'd ask my son before doing anything.
